newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen mixed amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen mixed amid profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are expected to open mixed on on Tuesday's settlement day, with profit-taking offset by fresh blue-chip buying, dealers said.
The 100-share index might close slightly higher on buying that could be led by Hub Power Company, which reached full commercial production last week, dealer Shaukat Hussain said.
On Monday, the Karachi index closed 4.96 points, or 0.31 percent, up at 1,593.61 amid 235 losers and 90 gainers in a low turnover of 26.6 million compared to Friday's 34.5 million
